root_cause.text: A race condition in the OpenVPN TCP transport driver where a concurrent tcp_close() sets sk->sk_socket to NULL via sock_orphan() while ovpn_tcp_socket_detach() dereferences it without locking, leading to a NULL pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that "tcp_close(sk) ... sets sk->sk_socket to NULL" while the peer is on the release list, and "ovpn_tcp_socket_detach() will attempt to dereference sk->sk_socket ... crash due to sk->sk_socket being NULL." The patch fixes this by acquiring sk->sk_callback_lock (which is held during sock_orphan()) and testing sk->sk_socket before accessing its ops.

intent_record.intent_summary: Acquire the socket callback lock to safely check for NULL before restoring socket operations, preventing a race with tcp_close.
intent_record.what: Replaced unprotected assignment of sk->sk_socket->ops with a write-locked check to ensure sk->sk_socket is not NULL before assignment.
intent_record.how: This prevents a race condition with tcp_close() which can set sk->sk_socket to NULL via sock_orphan(). The lock (sk_callback_lock) is the same one used by sock_orphan, ensuring consistency.

candidates.rationale: Dereferences sk->sk_socket without holding a lock, allowing a concurrent tcp_close() to set sk->sk_socket to NULL via sock_orphan(), causing a NULL pointer dereference.
